title: Open Seminar; Queer Spain
description: This seminar interrogates representations of gender, erotic desire, sexual anatomy, and sexuality in modern and contemporary Spanish discourse. Marshaling current critical and theoretical approaches, this course defines the concept of queer and examines how Spain has constructed normat ive and non-normative notions of masculinities, femininities, sex, and sexuality. We apply a critical lens to primary texts in order to interpret or reinterpret them within the fraught and unstable contexts of gender expression, biological sex, and sexualities.
